description: Keeps the pinned actions, the dev-time npm packages and the pinned Claude Code current. The mod itself has no npm packages.

packageRules.description: The pinned actions in one pull request a month.
The tooling's minor and patch releases in one pull request a month; each major comes on its own, so its release notes are read alone.
typescript-eslint cannot load TypeScript past 6.0, so `typescript` (the linter's) stays on 6.x while `typescript-7` is the compiler that CI and the hooks run.

customManagers.description: The one Claude Code version CI tests and screens.yml photographs: check.yml (twice), screens.yml and tools/pane_screens.ts, raised together. A raise that draws the pane differently fails screens.yml until `npm run screens -- render` is committed.
